static_proof.note: Idempotency is deliberately NOT claimed and is not the safety property. An earlier revision claimed every statement was IF NOT EXISTS so a re-run was a no-op; that described intended operator practice as an enforced property. IF NOT EXISTS skips silently, which is indistinguishable from success, and the trailing ALTER TABLE ... ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY was unguarded entirely. The boundary is now a fail-closed precondition that refuses, and table creation is unguarded so a race fails loudly.
static_proof.rls_preserved: Enabled on both tables with zero policies, matching production. Replaying without it would yield a schema strictly more permissive than production.
